name: benchmark-compare
description: This page compares Epoch 2 send-work searches from four browser providers for the same randomly generated work roots: nano-rspow-web v0.10.0, the vendored NanoPow v5.1.13 bundle, nanocurrency v2.5.0's WASM-backed `computeWork`, and the published nano-pow v5.2.2 package.
